description: Captured API responses. Regenerate with `npm run contracts:generate`. The Swift and Kotlin test suites decode every entry; a failing decode means the backend response shape changed.

entries.name: me
entries.description: A fresh account: tier free, and checklist_template null — the common case, where the client falls back to its built-in DEFAULT_CHECKLIST.

entries.name: error-402
entries.description: 402: the Pro gate (requireEntitlement). Returned by GET /garage, the parts/measurements routes and the setups routes for a free account; every client maps this one body to its paywall rather than to a sync error.

entries.name: billing-legacy-claim
entries.description: The Android transitional build's paid-app claim (X-TE-Client required; honoured before LEGACY_CUTOFF). Every billing write answers with the fresh entitlement.

entries.name: checklist-template-set
entries.description: Replace the prep-checklist template. Null or [] clears it.

entries.name: me-checklist-template
entries.description: The signed-in user with a customized prep-checklist template.

entries.name: leaderboard-opt-in
entries.description: Toggle the per-track leaderboard opt-in, and the lap-sharing consent (NS-35) stacked on top of it.

entries.name: track-leaderboard
entries.description: The per-track community leaderboard: opted-in users' best laps at the same catalog track. `you` marks the viewer's own row; `lap_id` is non-null only when that row's owner shares the lap itself.

entries.name: leaderboard-lap
entries.description: One shared leaderboard lap: its racing line and gridded channel traces, with nothing user-entered. `channels` is the one Pro field and is null for a free account.

entries.name: units-set
entries.description: Choose the unit system the logbook is shown in: "metric" or "imperial". Display-only — nothing stored changes.

entries.name: me-units-metric
entries.description: The signed-in user after choosing metric units.

entries.name: events-list
entries.description: All events with lap aggregates and computed stats (withComputed).

entries.name: event-detail
entries.description: One event with its sessions, laps and setup sheets. Populated stats branch.

entries.name: youtube-draft
entries.description: The upload form's pre-filled title, description and visibility (Pro), and the connected account it uploads to (null when none).

entries.name: youtube-upload
entries.description: A clip's YouTube upload as the lap page draws it: status, progress 0…1, privacy, the youtu.be link once done, and the words for a failure or a wait.

entries.name: event-detail-no-laps
entries.description: Event with no laps: best_ms and consistency are both null.

entries.name: event-setups-prefill
entries.description: Copy-forward prefill for a blank setup form.

entries.name: tracks-list
entries.description: Tracks with per-track aggregates, plus the best-per-event series no client renders any more (kept so shipped app builds keep decoding — see src/db.ts).

entries.name: track-setups
entries.description: Setup-vs-lap-times rows for a track.

entries.name: catalog
entries.description: Seeded canonical track catalog backing event-form suggestions.

entries.name: car-catalog
entries.description: Seeded car catalog: one row per generation with wheelbase, steering ratio (nullable — never a guess) and provenance; backs the vehicle form's picker and pre-fills a vehicle's geometry at pick time.

entries.name: vehicles-list
entries.description: The user's garage vehicles.

entries.name: vehicle-steering-fit
entries.description: The per-session steering fits behind the vehicle form's measured-ratio line (#223): steeringFit over the car's most recent channel-carrying sessions, newest first, only those that fit. The client pools them against the wheelbase in the form.

entries.name: garage
entries.description: Every vehicle with accrued hours, parts, measurements and computed wear.

entries.name: share-public
entries.description: Public share page data. Deliberately reduced: no notes, email, per-lap data or garage/setup linkage.

entries.name: item-share-event-create
entries.description: Share one event: its link, minted on first use and answered again after (200). Free.

entries.name: item-share-event
entries.description: The event's share link if there is one; 404 when it isn't shared.

entries.name: item-share-session-create
entries.description: Share one session: the same shape with kind "session" and a /share/s/ link.

entries.name: item-share-session
entries.description: The session's share link if there is one; 404 when it isn't shared.

entries.name: shared-event
entries.description: A shared event (unauthenticated): the event detail as the owner reads it, narrowed to the lap data — notes, checklist, costs, setups and the garage link null or empty — with `pro` the owner's tier and `clip` only while the owner has Pro.

entries.name: shared-session
entries.description: A shared session (unauthenticated): the same shape with the one session, and the header's best, lap count, consistency and weather worked out from it alone.

entries.name: item-share-lap-create
entries.description: Share one lap: the same shape with kind "lap" and a /share/l/ link.

entries.name: item-share-lap
entries.description: The lap's share link if there is one; 404 when it isn't shared.

entries.name: item-share-compare-create
entries.description: Share two laps compared (lap :id is side A, :otherId side B, both the caller's and at one track): kind "compare" and a /share/c/ link.

entries.name: item-share-compare
entries.description: The comparison's share link if there is one; 404 when it isn't shared.

entries.name: shared-lap
entries.description: A shared lap (unauthenticated): the shared-session shape cut down to the one lap — its row, its own channel entry, the header's figures its own — with `lap_id` naming it. The trace is kept only when the lap is the session's best, the lap it was drawn from.

entries.name: shared-compare
entries.description: Two shared laps compared (unauthenticated): { kind, name, pro, a, b }, each side { session_id, lap_id, event } with `event` as in a shared lap.

entries.name: item-share-lap-delete
entries.description: Stop sharing the lap.

entries.name: item-share-compare-delete
entries.description: Stop sharing the comparison.

entries.name: event-create
entries.description: Create an event.

entries.name: event-update
entries.description: Update an event.

entries.name: session-create
entries.description: Create a session with laps.

entries.name: session-update
entries.description: Update a session — only the keys present are written (NS-40).

entries.name: laps-append
entries.description: Append laps to a session.

entries.name: track-create
entries.description: Create a track directly.

entries.name: vehicle-create
entries.description: Create a garage vehicle.

entries.name: vehicle-update
entries.description: Update a vehicle.

entries.name: part-create
entries.description: Add a consumable part.

entries.name: part-update
entries.description: Update a part.

entries.name: part-refresh
entries.description: One-tap replacement: retires the part and inserts a same-spec successor.

entries.name: part-equip
entries.description: Put a spare back on the car as of a date, taking off whatever shares its place; `unequipped` lists the ids it took off (empty here: a rear pair swaps no front pair).

entries.name: part-mount-edit
entries.description: When a part went on the car, edited after the fact: moves its latest mount's start and whatever came off the car at the old point with it; `moved` lists those parts' ids (empty here: nothing came off).

entries.name: part-unequip
entries.description: Take a part off the car as of a date without retiring it — it goes to the shelf.

entries.name: measurement-create
entries.description: Log a wear measurement.

entries.name: setup-upsert
entries.description: Upsert a day's setup sheet.

entries.name: share-set
entries.description: Claim a share slug.

entries.name: setup-delete
entries.description: Delete a setup sheet.

entries.name: lap-delete
entries.description: Delete a single lap.

entries.name: session-delete
entries.description: Delete a session.

entries.name: measurement-delete
entries.description: Delete a measurement.

entries.name: part-delete
entries.description: Delete a part.

entries.name: vehicle-delete
entries.description: Delete a vehicle.

entries.name: track-update
entries.description: Update a track (name / goal time).

entries.name: track-delete
entries.description: Delete a track.

entries.name: event-delete
entries.description: Delete an event.

entries.name: share-clear
entries.description: Disable sharing.

entries.name: item-share-event-delete
entries.description: Stop sharing an event: its link answers 404 from now on.

entries.name: item-share-session-delete
entries.description: Stop sharing a session.

entries.name: error-400
entries.description: 400: missing required field.

entries.name: error-401
entries.description: 401: no session.

entries.name: error-404
entries.description: 404: not found, or owned by another user.

entries.name: me-pro-legacy
entries.description: The signed-in user once entitled: tier pro, source legacy, no expiry.

entries.name: wrapped
entries.description: Season Wrapped (NS-36): the season's numbers for one calendar year, past events only. `pro` is the one tier-dependent field — null for a free account; for Pro, the favorite tire and top speed, each null when there is no data.

entries.name: share-wrapped
entries.description: A shared Season Wrapped (unauthenticated): the same shape as GET /wrapped/:year with no `pro` key — the free card set only.

entries.name: me-profile-set
entries.description: Replace the driver profile (NS-38). Answers with the stored profile, trimmed and with unknown keys dropped; null clears it.

entries.name: me-profile
entries.description: The driver profile, headed by the owner's name, picture and tier — the same route a coach reads under /students/:studentId.

entries.name: coaching-invite
entries.description: Mint a single-use invite link for a coach (Pro). The token is in `url` and is shown only here; only its hash is stored.

entries.name: coaching-invite-preview
entries.description: What opening an invite link shows: whose logbook, and whether accepting would work.

entries.name: coaching-accept
entries.description: Accept an invite: the caller becomes a read-only coach of the student. Burns the link.

entries.name: coaching-as-coach
entries.description: Coaching from the coach's side: the students whose logbooks they can read.

entries.name: student-events
entries.description: A coach's view of a student's events: the event list with notes, checklist and costs sent as null.

entries.name: student-event-detail
entries.description: A coach's view of one event: sessions, laps, trace and channels (stripped to the student's tier, here Pro) — notes null, setups empty.

entries.name: student-tracks
entries.description: A coach's view of a student's tracks, with the course notes sent as null.

entries.name: student-vehicles
entries.description: A coach's view of a student's cars: the whole vehicle row, modifications included.

entries.name: student-profile
entries.description: A coach's view of the student's driver profile; `pro` is the student's tier, which the coach's client opens the channel panel by.

entries.name: comment-create-coach
entries.description: A coach comments on a place on a student's lap (NS-52). `dist_m` is whole metres from the start/finish line along that lap; `lap_id` alone is the lap, neither the session.

entries.name: comments-feed
entries.description: What was said to the caller, newest first, both roles at once — here a student with two unread comments from their coach. `student` is null on the caller's own logbook.

entries.name: comment-create
entries.description: The logbook's owner replies into one coach's thread; `coach_id` names it.

entries.name: comment-update
entries.description: The author edits their own comment; `edited_at` is set.

entries.name: comments-seen
entries.description: Mark the event's comments from other people as read; `seen` is how many it marked.

entries.name: comments-event
entries.description: Every thread on one of the owner's events, oldest first, with each thread's coach and whether they can still read it (`active`).

entries.name: comments-student-event
entries.description: A coach's own thread on a student's event — never another coach's. `seen` on the coach's own rows is the read receipt.

entries.name: comments-seen-coach
entries.description: A coach marks the student's replies on an event as read.

entries.name: comment-delete
entries.description: Delete a comment: its author, or the owner of the logbook it is on.

entries.name: coaching
entries.description: Coaching from the student's side: their coaches (with when each last looked) and their unused invites.

entries.name: coaching-invite-delete
entries.description: Withdraw an unused invite.

entries.name: coaching-student-delete
entries.description: A coach stops coaching a student.

entries.name: coaching-coach-delete
entries.description: A student revokes a coach; that coach's next read under /students/:studentId is a 404.
